issues.title: ketos segtest fails with IndexError in segmentation.py when building the pixel metrics table (aux + regions only)
issues.disposition: Fixed: pixel metric rows use compact metric indices, verified with bundled-model segtest.

issues.title: ppocrv6: inference differs from training because SE pooling sees the static-width padding; spurious characters at the line end
issues.disposition: Deferred: requires padding-aware architecture or training-width metadata, plus accuracy validation on trained PP-OCR models.

issues.title: `class_mapping` and `_full_class_mapping` disagree in models trained with `ketos segtrain --resize new` → regions get the wrong names (kraken 7.0.1)
issues.disposition: Fixed: rebuild fine-tuning targets and synchronize checkpoint class mappings. Training/checkpoint round-trip regression passes. Previously mislabelled model files are not rewritten automatically.

issues.title: Conflict of relative paths in XML files
issues.disposition: Fixed: XML image references are relative to output directory; regression tested.

issues.title: extract_polygons fills outside-polygon with black (cval=0), degrading recognition on bitonal images
issues.disposition: Deferred: configurable masking changes training and inference preprocessing; historical branch archived and retained.

issues.title: Failed to install on Colab and Streamlit Community Cloud
issues.disposition: Investigated: Python and dependency installation are being verified natively on Windows.

issues.title: Fine-tuning with segtrain does not start "WARNING Setting baseline location to baseline"
issues.disposition: Investigated: recognition, segmentation, and reading-order training smoke tests pass on Windows.

issues.title: Excessive horizontal segmentation
issues.disposition: Deferred feature: force horizontal fragment joining inside regions. Needs representative manuscript images and rules preventing cross-column joins.

issues.title: Tables layout annotation and segmentation
issues.disposition: Reviewed annotation question: existing region/baseline training can annotate tables; reliable table structure extraction requires annotated data and evaluation.

issues.title: add proportion of correctly read letters in ketos test
issues.disposition: Deferred reporting feature: include per-codepoint frequencies alongside the confusion matrix. Existing aggregate accuracy metrics are retained.

issues.title: Infinite loop in `boundary_tracing()` — an interaction cap is missing
issues.disposition: Fixed: boundary tracing detects repeated states and handles isolated pixels; regression tested.

issues.title: Segmentation Fine-Tuning leads to 0 line detection
issues.disposition: Reviewed model-specific fine-tuning report; current Windows training smoke tests pass. The original 30-page training data/model are not available for reproduction.

issues.title: Allow `native` input or remove it as the default output
issues.disposition: Deferred input-format feature: independently loading native JSON segmentation needs an input parser and persistent image-path semantics. XML remains the supported reusable interchange format.

issues.title: Problem with assigning a line to a region if it's too close to the region border
issues.disposition: Reviewed region assignment example. Changing spatial tolerance requires a validated corpus so neighboring region/column assignments do not regress.

issues.title: Failure to read varying text sizes in a Newspaper page
issues.disposition: Reviewed model-specific font-size sensitivity report. Recognition accuracy across newspaper scales requires evaluating the supplied model/corpus, separate from Windows installation.

issues.title: improve polygons of bottom lines
issues.disposition: Reviewed bottom-line polygon issue and retained Evarin-improve-polygons history as an archive tag. Historical geometry changes require accuracy comparisons on representative pages.

issues.title: Consider integrating Kraken with the Hugging Face hub
issues.disposition: Deferred: Hugging Face integration is a new service feature, separate from Windows compatibility.

issues.title: [feature request] Training with Metal Performance Shaders
issues.disposition: Out of scope: Apple MPS-specific request; Windows CPU/CUDA is the requested platform.

issues.title: add testfilename in testing
issues.disposition: Deferred reporting feature: per-input filenames in aggregate evaluation output. The existing contrib/test_per_file.py utility provides per-file evaluation.
